title: Task-Spec Frontmatter v2.2
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block at the top of a Task-Spec v2.2 file. Mirrors the field reference in references/concepts/agent-contract.md. v2.2 makes the sign-off envelope (signed_off_sig) a real, key-optional HMAC-SHA256 contract.

id.description: Task identifier. Must match T-YYYYMMDD-slug. Must equal filename basename.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Only ready specs are eligible for dispatch.

format_version.description: Task-Spec format version. v3 is current (adds profile/parent/accepted*); v1/v2 retained for legacy.

profile.description: Profile scaling required zones to effort/blast-radius (v3). See references/concepts/profiles.md.

parent.description: FEATURE-altitude PRD/SDD (path or url) this task decomposes from, or (none). The task DISTILLS it, never embeds it (v3).

effort.description: Six-tier t-shirt size (v3.4). LEAVES (runnable atoms): XS/S/M (recommend Kimi) and L (recommend GLM, requires execution_backend:glm + ONE coherent done-condition). The leaf write-surface (|touches_paths ∪ creates_paths|) is gate-checked: XS<=1, S<=2, M<=3, L<=5. NODES (decomposition directives, NOT runnable): XL/XXL MUST declare a `children:` list (>=2 for XL, >=3 for XXL) and expand into leaf slices — there is NO route out to SDD. See references/concepts/effort-gate.md.

agent.description: Preferred agent (any, claude, codex, kimi, cursor, etc.).

depends_on.description: List of T-IDs that must be done before this task is ready.

children.description: The leaf/child Task-Specs an XL/XXL NODE decomposes into (>=2 for XL, >=3 for XXL). Only nodes carry this; a worker dispatches the children, never the node. Leaves omit it. See references/concepts/effort-gate.md.

touches_paths.description: Authoritative list of paths this task is allowed to modify. Leaves declare their write surface here (gate-checked against the tier budget); an XL/XXL NODE owns no write surface, so it declares `touches_paths: []` (its children do the writing).

source_note.description: Free-form note about where this task originated.

created.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the spec was authored.

linear_ref.description: DEPRECATED Linear-specific alias of tracker_ref. Still accepted; migrate a non-empty value to the vendor-neutral tracker_ref.

tracker_ref.description: Convenience backlink to the tracker issue this spec is registered as: '<tracker>:<issue-ref>' (e.g. linear:ENG-42, github:#42, jira:PROJ-42) or (none). Written BACK into the spec by the task-specs-to-issues REGISTER pass (Pass ①) after a successful upsert — never by the author. The idempotency KEY is the marker carried on the issue, NOT this field, so tooling must tolerate tracker_ref being (none) (e.g. a CI run that cannot write back to the repo). One mirror per tracker; the spec always wins on content.

execution_backend.description: Target executor type. OPEN STRING — the backend names itself; the values above are non-normative examples, not an allow-list. Used by dispatch tooling to route the task. Note: an effort:L spec is accepted only when this is 'glm' (see references/concepts/effort-gate.md).

signed_off.description: Autonomy contract flag. ONLY safe-to-delegate.sh --stamp may set this to true.

signed_off_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the stamp, or (none).

accepted.description: Post-execution acceptance flag (v3). ONLY accept-task.sh may set this to true, AFTER execution closes the loop (evals re-run from clean checkout + blast-radius + envelope).

task_spec_version.description: Version of the task-spec skill that authored the file.

signed_off_sig.description: B2 HMAC sign-off envelope (v2.2). Format: hmac-sha256-v1:<keyid>:<hex>. The HMAC-SHA256 is computed by safe-to-delegate.sh --stamp over a CANONICAL fixed-field payload: newline-joined id, body_digest (sha256 of the spec body after the closing frontmatter '---'), signed_off, signed_off_by, signed_off_at — EXCLUDING this signed_off_sig line itself and independent of frontmatter line order. keyid is the first 8 hex of sha256(key). KEY-OPTIONAL: this field is present only when a signing key was resolved at stamp time (TASKSPEC_SIGNING_KEY or .git/info/taskspec-signing-key) AND a sha256 provider (openssl|shasum|sha256sum) was available. When absent, the sign-off is structural-only (Tier 2). validate-task-spec.sh Check 17 recomputes and compares: match = Tier 1 (full crypto trust); absent/no-key = Tier 2 (structural-only, supervised dispatch only); mismatch/malformed = Tier 3 (hard fail). HMAC is symmetric: it binds 'a repo-key holder stamped this', not per-author non-repudiation.

requires.description: B3 OPTIONAL isolation declaration. Tells a dispatcher what the executor's sandbox must provide; accept-task.sh GATE D reports it (document-and-warn — the bash tool cannot enforce egress). Absent on a non-full profile is silent; a full-profile spec with no requires.network is warned (not blocked).

base_image.description: Container/runtime image the eval set assumes.

deps.description: Packages the sandbox must provision (list or scalar).

network.description: Egress posture the sandbox enforces. deny is the safe default for unattended full tasks.

baseline_ref.description: B3 OPTIONAL. Git ref of the UNPATCHED baseline used by accept-task.sh --gold-sanity (GATE E). The eval set must FAIL on this ref and PASS on the current state; an eval that passes here too is non-discriminating and is BLOCKED. A --base flag overrides this.

reference_solution.description: B3 OPTIONAL alias/fallback for baseline_ref (used by accept-task.sh --gold-sanity when baseline_ref is absent). A pointer (git ref) to a known-good reference state.

signed_off_envelope.description: DEPRECATED structured form of the sign-off envelope, retained for forward-compatibility. The realized v2.2 envelope is the flat string field signed_off_sig (hmac-sha256-v1:<keyid>:<hex>) written by safe-to-delegate.sh --stamp; that string is the source of truth. This object form is reserved for a future per-author detached-signature upgrade (e.g. Ed25519/DSSE) and is not written by the current gate.

signature.description: Hex MAC over the canonical payload.
